To connect AMS 2 Pro unit(s) to A1 series printer, an A1 series AMS Hub (SA013) is required.
We recommend to purchase A1 Combo directly for more convenient usage.

children.children: Multi-color Printing - The most reliable multi-color system
Full-auto Calibration - You don't have to do ANY manual tuning
Large Print Volume - Print a helmet in 1-piece
1-click to Print - As easy as your copier
Reliable High Speed - Finish your project on time, every time
Active Flow Control - Smooth surfaces, sharp edges
Print Like A PRO From Your Very First Use
Start printing with a few clicks on your phone, no need to worry about the tedious settings.
Browse endless selections of high-quality models tailored to your printers on MakerWorld!
Print Like A PRO From Your Very First Use
Start printing with a few clicks on your phone, no need to worry about the tedious settings.
Browse endless selections of high-quality models tailored to your printers on MakerWorld!
A1 handles various calibrations all by itself. It meticulously calibrates the Z-offset, bed-level, vibration resonance and nozzle pressure for EVERY print job, automatically.

The AMS lite has been recognized as the most reliable multi-color 3D printing solution. It also features RFID-sync to automatically match the best print settings for your Bambu filaments, delivering perfect print quality without manual tuning of the filament profile.
The High-speed You Can Truly Rely On

A1 is equipped with low-drag linear rails, a powerful MCU,accelerometers, a nozzle pressure sensor, and an advanced motion control system that maximizes their potential. Its high-speed performance is built on a solid foundation, ensuring consistent reliability with stable and uniform output for every print.
3D printing is a complex task where many things can go wrong. The A1 is equipped with a comprehensive print status monitoring system to help keep the print job in check.
Generous Space for You to Expand Your Fantasy
A1 features 256mm*256mm*256mm build volume, bigger than most of the entry-level printers. Print a helmet in one go, we got you.
The A1 can calibrate parameters to match tiny individual differences between each drive motor. This compensates for the unwanted harshness of motor noise.
Start & Control on Whatever Device You Prefer

Not only can you connect your A1 to any device you prefer through Bambu Cloud Service, but you can also do so through LAN-only mode. We offer fully customizable connection options to match your privacy preferences.

children.children:
Bambu Lab A1 - First Looks and Amazing 3D Printing
                      Results!
1. Do you have an official unboxing guide?

dangerouslySetInnerHTML.__html: A: Yes, please refer to this wiki link  for the unboxing video guide.

children.children: 2. What is the maximum print size of the A1?

dangerouslySetInnerHTML.__html: A: 256 * 256 *256 mm³. For more details, please check here.

A: 1. Low-temperature filaments such as PLA, PETG, TPU, and support materials for PLA and PETG (Support for PLA, PVA, HIPS, etc.).
2. Conventional high-temperature filaments such as ABS, ASA, PC, PA, PA-CF/GF, PET-CF/GF, PPA-CF/GF, etc.
Kind Reminder:
The standard nozzle is made of stainless steel. When printing filaments containing hard particles (CF, GF, etc.) such as PLA-CF/GF, PLA Glow-in-the-dark, PETG-CF/GF and PAHT-CF/GF, it is necessary to replace the nozzle with hardened steel to prevent excessive wear.
Due to the A1's open-frame design and lower chamber temperature, there is a risk of reduced interlayer strength and increased warping for large-sized models and models with high filling density when using conventional high-temperature filaments such as ABS, ASA, PC, PA, PA-CF/GF, PET-CF/GF, PPA-CF/GF, etc. on the A1. However, these high-temperature filaments can be used on the A1 to print small-sized models with low filling density. The printing results may vary depending on the filaments' dry and wet state, the characteristics of the model itself, printing parameters, and the ambient temperature. For more details, please check here.

children.children: 4. Is it OK to enclose the A1?

dangerouslySetInnerHTML.__html: A: We don't recommend enclosing the A1. For more details, please check here.

children.children:
5. Can you use multiple AMS lite units with the A1 for up to
                    16 color prints?

dangerouslySetInnerHTML.__html: A: The A1 can only support one AMS lite, which means it can print with a maximum of 4 colors. For more details, please check here.

children.children: 6. Can I use the AMS on the A1?

dangerouslySetInnerHTML.__html: A: Yes. To connect the printer to the AMS, an AMS HUB (SA013) accessory is needed. The AMS hub accessory is specifically designed for A1-series 3D printers, serving as a standardized hub for seamless connectivity and integrated functionality between the AMS, AMS 2 Pro, and AMS HT.

children.children:
7. Can AMS lite be mounted on the beam of the A1 to reduce
                    space occupation? If so,how should I proceed with the
                    operation?

dangerouslySetInnerHTML.__html:
A: Please visit our  MakerWorld model website,  where you will be able to find the model supports, installation tutorial, and purchase links for accessory screws. Additionally, you can also refer to our  wiki page  for more related information.


For more details, please check here.

children.children:
8. If I install AMS lite on the beam, will the filament
                    spool slide down, or will it affect the accuracy of
                    vibration compensation?

dangerouslySetInnerHTML.__html: A: As long as the AMS lite is correctly installed, the filament spool should not slide down, even if the previous two spools have a certain forward tilt angle. Additionally, to avoid affecting the accuracy of vibration compensation, you can add reinforcement to the column. For more details, please check here.

children.children: 9. Will you sell official refurbished A1 printers?

dangerouslySetInnerHTML.__html:
A: Currently, Factory Refurbished A1 units are only available for sale within the Chinese domestic market. There are no plans for overseas sales of Factory Refurbished units at this time.
For your reference, all Refurbished units will have an "R" mark located on the back of the Base Housing, near the power cord plug.For more details, please check here.

children.children:
10. Are the A1 3D printers currently available for sale from
                    the same batch that was recalled in January 2024?

dangerouslySetInnerHTML.__html: A: No,they aren't. A1 3D printers sold after January 30, 2024 are not from the same batch as those recalled before.They already contain all the necessary fixes to mitigate the heatbed cable issue which caused the recall.
